reviews.x: However, as far as products go... I really love everything about the way this company presents itself, it's design, it's product and how well the product performs. It has a great warranty (my last one from a different company died in less than 5 months with no recourse), and it came with a bunch of great stuff, including this weird little paddle (the green & white thing) I couldn't figure out at first was a cleaning utensil, and now I really love. It helps you pull the hair from the brush.  At a

I was so skeptical of the good reviews. I have thick hair and live in the south with all the humidity. This was super easy to use and straightened my hair FAST! I am hooked and want to tell anyone who will listen. This straightener is a game changer! Cannot be beat for the price and the convenience!!

I love this straightening brush with ionic properties! My hair is fine grey and prone to being frizzy. This brush is so easy to use and my hair gives me a very pulled together and polished look. I am so pleased!  Update: I have had this brush for about three weeks now. It is incredible. Three weeks of perfect hair. Amazing!

I wanted to love this straightener but I don't. My hair is long, not too thick, slightly wavy but mostly straight. I wanted this to help smooth out that first day wash frizz. It makes my hair look poofier after using. It kicks out any shorter hairs. I've tried using it different ways to smooth it out...but my hair looks fluffy. Nothing like the results I get with a straightener. It also has a bad smell for the first 5-10 minutes of using and while it heats up.

reviews.t: Perfect. I'll never go back to flat plate straighters.
reviews.x: I gave it 4 out of 5 stars just because the design makes it really hard to get the baby hairs close to your head. But using this straightener it's so easy and so so fast. I use it just enough to get rid of most of my frizzies and it helps my hair not be staticky all day. I love it.

I’m impressed! I just used this hair straightening brush for the first time and I’m impressed! It is easy to use and it only took me about 10 min from mess to sleek! I need to mention that I have “two left hands” when comes to styling my hair. My hair is very dry and puffy. Nothing worked for me in the past. I tried to use the hair iron in the past with horrible results. This brush is great and I’m very happy with this purchase.

reviews.t: Easy to use, happy with results!
reviews.x: Bought this for my teenage daughter who has thick, wavy hair. Item was very easy to use, lightweight compared to standard straighteners and results are amazing with a smooth, polished look. Recommend using this with hair that is dry, sectioned off and then used in little sections.

reviews.t: Amazing! Second use: not so good.
reviews.x: My Belifu Brush arrived today. It took about five minutes to create beautiful, sleek hair! Update: second time I used it, no temp lights and no heat. I’m returning it and asking for a replacement. I hope it works this time!

reviews.t: Was surprised at how well it worked!

This one wasn't the lowest priced, and definitely not the highest priced, but I have been very happy with its performance.  I keep mine on 340 degrees, and it does very well straightening my hair - and its very fast too!  I was really surprised at how well it worked. I did not like this product. I used as directed and my hair was left frizzish and still a bit wavy even after multiple tries.

I Love Love love this thing!! My daughter is mixed and has 4b 4c hair. Straightened it amazing. Simple and lighter than usual. Took way less time than traditional flat iron. Great price. Great product. Only thing I didn't like, it still doesn't get to the scalp fully to straighten it to the scalp. Definitely get this. The glove is to protect the hand from burning. It does. Mine has a small hole in the pinky.

I've just received my ionic hair straightening brush and will keep trying to work with it. There is a design flaw in the on/off temperature button.  I found as I wrapped my hand around the brush and pulled it through my hair I kept inadvertently increasing the temperature by just touching the button. Perhaps it should have been placed in another area?

I used the 380 temperature, and it took me 15 minutes to straighten my ride side. Overall I was very happy. My hair feels soft. I felt as though the hair wasnt at the level of a flat iron but I really do like this product.

My objective for ironing is to straighten my hair and seal the cuticle to reduce frizz.  I used the brush on max heat  (450F) and still didn't feel like it was hot enough (I only use 395F on my flat iron). Disclaimer: I typically wash and dry my hair at night and then style it in the morning. So my hair was completely dry. 1) It does not get to your roots ( as I expected) 2) but it FRIES your hair. I had it at one of the lowest setting and it made my hair look so dead. So disappointed. I gave it a few tries and it has been a few months since

For my hair type i still feel the need to run over it with a flat iron To keep it straight. I also have to use it everyday if I want to keep it straight. I do live in a humid environment so that might contribute.

reviews.t: If you have thick hair .. don’t bother you
reviews.x: I have no idea what the women in the videos were using bc this thing does nothing for my hair. I have wavy hair but certainly not hard to manage hair. I was hoping to be able to blow dry my hair and quickly straighten/smooth out my hair .. that would take me 10x longer than just using my straightener if it even completely the job. Not satisfied.

So I've got a new best friend! Lol I have always hated the time it to to straighten my hair but LOVE the look of it! Well now it takes minutes! Here's my daughters hair done in about 5 minutes! Great now shes gonna ask me to do it all the time. She already told me, "mommy now we dont have to use that other thing" (flat iron) lol

reviews.t: It was nice when it worked...
reviews.x: I bought this mid-January, it’s now March. I used this probably half a dozen times. It heated up nicely, worked well straightening my hair, no issues. Then... it just stopped heating up. Tried a couple different times and settings, and nothing. No heat. No straightening. Very disappointing- it lasted less than ten uses.

reviews.t: Great product, great price! Love mine!
reviews.x: I have long, curly hair, and this product straightens my hair so quickly and effortlessly. I don't think I will ever go back to a flat iron. I absolutely love it. Great price for the product too. I higy recommend this if you are in the market for a straightening brush.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise how quick and easy the brush is to use, often noting it saves time compared to traditional straighteners.
Many customers report smooth, sleek, frizz-reducing results, including on thick, wavy, or textured hair.
Several reviewers note the brush does not get as close to the scalp or as straight as a flat iron, especially for baby hairs or shorter hairs.
A few reviewers report negative experiences such as frizzier or poofier hair, smoke, or the device failing to heat up.
Some customers mention design issues, such as a poorly placed temperature button or difficulty reaching certain areas.
